fields.acceptance: internal/run brief tests render a BriefInput with two request notes, one multi-line (section after Change set, both notes verbatim in order under their headings) and one with none (no section, bytes unchanged from today). A new cmd/rhiza testscript request-notes-brief.txtar queues a request with two --note values, lets the daemon draw its run (fake rex, as plan-requests.txtar does), runs that plan run by hand with a fake claude, and finds both notes in the planner session's brief.md; (failure case) a plan run started for a request with no notes has no Request notes section in its brief. Run: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/run/ -run Brief, go test -trimpath -p 2 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(request-notes-brief|brief-files)$'
fields.must_not: Change brief.md for a run that is no request's; change spawned children's briefs (RenderSpawnBrief); add a field to the run journal; start a process in the testscript unless it is listed on processScripts with its reason
fields.statement: The brief.md of every agent step session of a request's plan run shows the request's notes in a Request notes section after the Change set section, as request-notes-in-plan-brief says (each note verbatim under '### Note <n>', oldest first; run.BriefInput gains the notes; stepRunner.fillSession reads them from requests.json by the run's ID); a run that is no request's, or one whose request has no notes, renders no such section
